overview: A flexible femtosecond pump–probe platform. Spectral separation between pump and probe channels improves rejection of scattered pump light, while a mechanical delay line resolves the transient response from sub-nanosecond heat flow to acoustic echoes.
overviewZh: 基于飞秒泵浦-探测的柔性平台。泵浦与探测通道的光谱分离可抑制泵浦散射背景，机械延迟线同时覆盖亚纳秒热输运响应与声学回波。
principle: Complementary edge filters select different spectral bands from one femtosecond laser for pump and probe, suppressing scattered pump light. The modulated pump heats the transducer; delayed probe reflectance tracks cooling. A multilayer thermal model fits the lock-in signal ratio to extract conductivity or interface conductance when sensitivity permits.
principleZh: 利用互补边缘滤光片，从同一飞秒激光光谱中选取不同波段作为泵浦光和探测光，抑制泵浦散射串扰。调制泵浦加热金属传感层，延迟探测光读取冷却过程中的反射率变化；在灵敏度允许时，用多层导热模型拟合锁相信号比，提取热导率或界面热导。
